title: Stretched Profits and Cooling Demand Put Bitcoin Rally on Pause — For Now: Report
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Stretched Profits and Cooling Demand Put Bitcoin Rally on Pause — For Now: Report A new report from CryptoQuant still declares a bitcoin bull market but says a “healthy correction” could be coming. This post Stretched Profits and Cooling Demand Put Bitcoin Rally on Pause — For Now: Report first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
